tasks.title: Find/Replace UI
tasks.description: Create SearchPanel component with search state management, regex-based search logic, keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+F, Ctrl+H, F3, Shift+F3, Escape), match highlighting, and replace functionality (single and all).
test_criteria: Typing query highlights matches in editor
tasks.impl_notes: A.1.1: Create SearchPanel component (www/src/components/SearchPanel.jsx). A.1.2: Add search state management to Editor. A.1.3: Implement search logic (regex-based). A.1.4: Wire keyboard shortcuts. A.1.5: Highlight matches in editor. A.1.6: Implement replace functionality. A.1.7: Add search panel CSS/styling.

tasks.title: Focus Mode
tasks.description: Implement focus mode that dims non-active paragraphs while keeping the active paragraph at full opacity. Includes settings toggle, body class, and keyboard shortcut.
test_criteria: Toggle in settings enables focus mode
tasks.impl_notes: A.2.1: Add focusMode to Settings context. A.2.2: Add focus mode class to document body. A.2.3: Track active paragraph/block element. A.2.4: Implement paragraph de-emphasis CSS. A.2.5: Keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+F) - optional.

tasks.title: Typewriter Mode
tasks.description: Implement typewriter mode that keeps the cursor vertically centered in the viewport when typing or navigating. Includes scroll centering on cursor move.
test_criteria: Toggle in settings enables typewriter mode
Cursor stays vertically centered when typing
tasks.impl_notes: A.3.1: Add typewriterMode to Settings context. A.3.2: Add typewriter mode class to document body. A.3.3: Implement scroll centering on cursor move. A.3.4: Keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+T) - optional.

tasks.title: Auto-Save Timer
tasks.description: Implement auto-save timer that automatically saves the document after a configurable interval (autoSaveInterval). Timer resets on each edit with debouncing. Shows 'Saving...' indicator.
test_criteria: Disabling auto-save in settings prevents auto-save
tasks.impl_notes: A.4.1: Access auto-save settings. A.4.2: Implement auto-save timer hook (useAutoSaveTimer.js). A.4.3: Reset timer on each edit (debounce). A.4.4: Show 'Saving...' indicator. A.4.5: Clear dirty flag after auto-save.

tasks.title: Rich Text Paste Handler
tasks.description: Handle rich text paste events by detecting clipboard content type and converting HTML to Markdown using TurndownService. Insert converted Markdown at cursor position with plain text fallback.
test_criteria: Paste in editor produces Markdown output
Plain text paste works as fallback
tasks.impl_notes: B.1.1: Add paste event handler to Editor. B.1.2: Detect clipboard content type. B.1.3: Integrate HTML-to-Markdown converter (TurndownService). B.1.4: Insert converted Markdown at cursor. B.1.5: Add fallback for plain text paste.

tasks.title: DocumentResult Headings Field
tasks.description: Add Heading struct to Rust model and populate headings array on document load. Update DocumentResult serialization to include headings field in API response.
test_criteria: Check API response includes headings array
Headings contain level, text, and position
tasks.impl_notes: B.2.1: Add Heading struct to Rust model. B.2.2: Add headings field to Document struct. B.2.3: Populate headings on document load. B.2.4: Update DocumentResult serialization.

tasks.title: Settings Missing Fields
tasks.description: Add focusMode, typewriterMode, and outlineVisible fields to Rust Settings struct. Update Settings JSON serialization and frontend Settings context. Add UI toggles for new settings.
tasks.impl_notes: B.3.1: Add fields to Rust Settings struct. B.3.2: Update Settings JSON serialization. B.3.3: Update frontend Settings context. B.3.4: Add UI toggles for new settings.

tasks.title: File Tree CRUD
tasks.description: Implement file tree create, rename, and delete operations via Tauri commands. Add context menu to Sidebar component with right-click options: New File, New Folder, Rename, Delete.
test_criteria: Right-click on file shows context menu
Right-click on folder shows context menu
'New File' creates file at correct path
'New Folder' creates folder at correct path
'Rename' prompts for new name and renames item
Error toast appears on operation failure
tasks.impl_notes: B.4.1: Add Tauri commands (create_file, create_folder, rename_item, delete_item). B.4.2: Implement Rust command handlers with path validation. B.4.3: Add context menu to Sidebar component. B.4.4: Wire menu actions to Tauri commands. B.4.5: Handle errors gracefully with toast notifications.

tasks.title: Undo/Redo Connection
tasks.description: Wire TipTap's built-in undo/redo engine to keyboard shortcuts. Ctrl+Z triggers undo, Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z triggers redo.
tasks.impl_notes: B.5.1: Verified Rust undo/redo engine exists. B.5.2: TipTap has built-in undo/redo. B.5.3: Add keyboard shortcuts to TipTap Editor (Ctrl+Z: undo, Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z: redo).

tasks.title: Drag-and-Drop File Open
tasks.description: Create DropZone overlay component that appears on dragenter and handles .md file drops. Validates file extension, extracts file path, and calls existing open file logic.
test_criteria: Dropping file opens it in editor
tasks.impl_notes: B.6.1: Create DropZone overlay component (full-window, dashed border). B.6.2: Handle drag events (dragenter, dragover, dragleave, drop). B.6.3: Extract and validate .md file from drop event. B.6.4: Call existing openFile handler. B.6.5: Add visual feedback (highlight drop zone, reject non-Markdown).

tasks.title: Settings Applied to TipTap Editor
tasks.description: Apply user settings (contentWidth, lineHeight, fontSize, fontFamily) from Settings context to TipTap editor container and content.
test_criteria: Change contentWidth in settings, verify editor max-width updates
Change lineHeight in settings, verify content line-height updates
Change fontSize in settings, verify content font-size updates
Change fontFamily in settings, verify content font-family updates
tasks.impl_notes: C.1.1-1.2: Read and apply contentWidth as max-width to TipTap editor container. C.1.3-1.4: Read and apply lineHeight to TipTap content. C.1.5-1.6: Read and apply fontSize to TipTap content. C.1.7-1.8: Read and apply fontFamily to TipTap content.

tasks.title: Recent Files UI
tasks.description: Create RecentFiles component to display list of recently opened files. Integrate in sidebar or menu, show last 10 files with name and path. Add clear history option.
test_criteria: Click on recent file opens it
List shows file name and path
tasks.impl_notes: C.2.1: Access recent files storage and parse list. C.2.2: Create RecentFiles component (list view). C.2.3: Add to sidebar or menu. C.2.4: Add clear recent files option.

tasks.title: Image Paste
tasks.description: Handle image paste (clipboard) and drag-and-drop by detecting image data, saving to workspace assets folder, and inserting Markdown image reference.
test_criteria: Paste image from clipboard inserts markdown reference
Drag image onto editor inserts markdown reference
Image saves to workspace assets folder
Error toast appears if save fails
tasks.impl_notes: C.3.1: Detect image data in paste (image/png, image/jpeg). C.3.2: Handle image paste (save to assets, insert ![](path)). C.3.3: Handle image drag-and-drop. C.3.4: Show error for unsupported images.

tasks.title: Outline Click Navigation
tasks.description: Implement click navigation in OutlinePanel - clicking a heading item should scroll TipTap editor to that heading's position and optionally set cursor.
test_criteria: Click on outline item scrolls editor to heading
Cursor moves to heading start position
tasks.impl_notes: C.4.1: Add click handler to outline items. C.4.2: Get heading position (character offset) from headings array. C.4.3: Scroll TipTap editor to heading position. C.4.4: Optionally set cursor to heading start.

tasks.title: Export UI
tasks.description: Create ExportModal component with format selection (HTML standalone, HTML linked-assets, PDF with page size options). Wire to backend export commands with progress indicator.
test_criteria: Export button in Toolbar opens ExportModal
PDF format exports with selected page size
tasks.impl_notes: C.5.1: Create ExportModal component with format selection. C.5.2: Wire export format selection. C.5.3: Call backend export commands. C.5.4: Show progress indicator. C.5.5: Show success/error notification. C.5.6: Add export button to Toolbar.

tasks.title: File Watcher UI Integration
tasks.description: Connect file watcher events to frontend notification system. Show notification when external change detected with options: Reload, Keep Current, Compare Later.
test_criteria: Modify file externally while app is open
tasks.impl_notes: C.6.1: Connect file watcher events to frontend. C.6.2: Show notification when external change detected. C.6.3: Provide user options (Reload, Keep Current, Compare Later). C.6.4: Handle file watcher errors gracefully.

tasks.title: Task Checkbox Toggle
tasks.description: Add click handler to task list checkboxes in TipTap to toggle markdown state between `- [ ]` and `- [x]`. Update document state with new syntax.
test_criteria: Click unchecked task checkbox changes to checked (- [ ] → - [x])
Click checked task checkbox changes to unchecked (- [x] → - [ ])
tasks.impl_notes: C.7.1: Add click handler to task list checkboxes in TipTap. C.7.2: Toggle markdown state. C.7.3: Update document state with new syntax.
